reviews.text: I ordered personalized cups for my daughter’s 40th birthday. They came in a fairly reasonable amount of time and were really cute. We celebrated her birthday less than a week ago and during the party, the labels started coming off. They didn’t even last for 3 hours! When I reached out to the company, they told me they were single use only so to be careful washing them. They never made it to a dishwasher or even a sink. We now have no keepsake from her birthday. These were $5 a cup and I’m extremely disappointed. I’ll never use Macorner again and I’ll be sure to let anyone else know my horrible experience

Two things made my service great. 
1. The quality of the product 
2. The Great customer service. 
RARELY do you see a product that looks as advertised. Your quality was way above my expectations. The USPS screwed up the delivery of my package. Your company took the time to track down my package and resend again.  Your company sets the Standards for Customer Service. It's refreshing to see a company that actually Cares about the customer 
Thanks
A really nice shirt that describes me perfectly 🫶🏾

Mein Paket ist nicht angekommen, da der Absender es falsch frankiert hat. Daraufhin habe ich ihnen geschrieben und zur Antwort bekommen, dass ich mich bei DHL melden soll. Das ist die Aufgabe des Absenders. Ich habe trotzdem dort angerufen und die Info erhalten, dass das Paket nicht mit den Versandkosten übereinstimmt, sprich es entweder zu groß oder schwer war. Auch nach zweimaliger Rückversicherung, dass es nicht meine Schuld war, bekomme ich immer noch die gleichen generischen Antworten und due Rückfrage nach meiner Adresse. Wir drehen uns seit Tagen im Kreis. Meine Ware ist nicht da und man versucht, mir die Schuld anzuhängen, sodass die knapp 50€ nicht zurückgezahlt werden können.
Items came in a timely manner. Happy with purchase.

DO NOT ORDER FROM MACORNER! This item was ordered for the 250th fourth of July celebration.  It arrived on July 5,  When I asked for a refund because it is useless, they stood on the policy that the production time and shipping fell within their guidelines.  They however, DID NOT factor holiday shipping schedules.  This is NOT coming from the USA.  Don't support a company that doesn't support USA consumers. They wouldn't even concede to the fact that the holiday affected their delivery time.  They only wanted to give me a discount on a FUTURE order! Never will I order from them again.

They responded quickly when I inquired about my order. Shipping was fast. Products were nice! I ordered 5 custom notebooks and pen sets for co-workers and myself. They came out so cute. I'll order again for sure!
You always wrap your item carefully and they arrive quickly. I love your selections.

My original package was damaged when it arrived.  I immediately contacted Macorner and they shipped my replacement order within a couple of days. It arrived unharmed.  The communication piece was top notch.  They were easy to contact and they responded within a timely fashion.  I will order from them again!
So far so good 👍
I received my order but it didn’t work.  I contacted customer service and sent them a picture.  They responded quickly and send another one to me
Exceptional product and fast delivery. Care for the customers needs.
Customer service was phenomenal in a messed up situation, which was no fault of theirs.  They were very quick to respond and very quick to help get things fixed.

The customized lamp is absolutely beautiful and is great keepsake. The customer service is amazing. There was a slight defect in the first lamp delivered and I immediately sent pictures to support. Within a few weeks, they sent me a replacement lamp and it is perfect. I will certainly buy more from this company. I am totally impressed.
Super, très réactif, je recommande !!

Their courier EVRi failed on delivery. EVRi eventually admitted their failure- Macorner didn’t take any responsibility for following through the issue we had. The delivery address was a business address - delivered at 22:10 on a Saturday night left outside the premises on an industrial estate. Obviously someone has picked it up. Macorner stood by the fact it was delivery successfully!! Offered a 30% refund or a replacement. I declined the replacement as the original was a gift. 30% is a joke. I will never use this company again. It’s even worse because you can’t speak to a human being all automated emails.

I have placed orders with Macorner and have never been disappointed. My last order that I just got was no exception. I ordered some shirts for an anniversary cruise. I order them in plenty of time. Much to my surprise my order got lost in transit. Macorner notified me of this situation. I didn't even realize it at the time. Not only did they notify me, they automatically processed a new order for me. I appreciate them so much letting me know. I replied in the email that they were special shirts and I needed them before a certain date which was fast approaching. Well I got the shirts prior to my trip. I have been so impressed with their communication with me, I can't brag enough. Macorner will be my go to. Never have I received such great customer from an online order.  Thank you Macorner!
Was delivered fast. Website was easy to navigate. My husband loved his shirt and glass. Will definitely order gifts again.
Quality and description

The mug is much smaller than expected. I would have liked to have had the opportunity to pay more for a larger size. 

Also, I wanted to order 2 mugs at the same time with different pictures. Every time I attempted this, the original picture was replaced with the second picture. I ended up having to use 2 DIFFERENT emails in 2 DIFFERENT orders in order to accomplish this. 

Finally, the shipping was very inaccurate and took forever. When they finally arrived,one showed up as an Amazon order and was put in a concierge locker, while the other showed up 2 weeks later(they were ordered within minutes of each other) and was dropped off in an unsecured area where signs expressly said DO NOT LEAVE PACKAGES HERE. 

I’m not ordering from this business again.

I placed an order for a charm bracelet for a graduation present. Upon tracking on the 1 July it clearly states getting ready for delivery. I contacted customer service because 8 days later and the item has still not been delivered. Customer service have advised it will be another 10 days before dispatch noting they have to engrave one word on the bracelet. It should not take over 20 days to deliver an item. I now have 24 hrs to purchase another gift and have requested cancellation and a refund. Do not buy from this company!

Following on from my review this company have now dispatched the item today, the same day I asked for the item to be cancelled because I informed them that this was a graduation present and it is to late now. They have sent the item anyway The item is being shipped from china, if I had known this I never would have placed the order.. Do not waste your money, time and effort by ordering from this company. This item is useless to me now, 20 days from placing the order and another 10 days after graduation.
Made things right
Made things right.
Was so very cool to get a professional shirt with customized lettering!   Grandkids love it!
Our product is exactly what we expected and the service from ordering to delivery was exceptional. Thank You!!!!

Ik heb een pet besteld voor vaderdag met een leuke tekst en foto. Op de preview zag het er goed uit maar eenmaal het product in handen zwaar teleurgesteld. Mailtje gestuurd en heb uiteindelijk pas 2/3 weken Na vaderdag het product binnen. En weer zwaar teleurgesteld. Maar ho maar dat je je geld terugkrijgt. Nee je krijgt je verzend kosten terug MET MOEITE!!! Neeee ik besteld hier nooit meer. Goedkope producten voor de hoofdprijs

I ordered a cap for Father's Day featuring a fun message and a photo. It looked good in the preview, but I was hugely disappointed once I actually had the product in hand. I sent an email, and it took until two or three weeks *after* Father's Day for the product to arrive. And I was hugely disappointed all over again. But there was absolutely no chance of getting a refund. No, you only get your shipping costs back—and even that is a struggle! No way am I ever ordering from here again. Cheap products sold at premium prices.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience. I ordered a personalized Father’s Day mouse pad, but it never arrived in time for Father’s Day. I was not aware the product was being manufactured and shipped from China, which resulted in significant delays. I contacted customer service multiple times requesting a refund, but instead of honoring my request, I was repeatedly told the item would be remade and shipped again. It is currently still stuck in Illinois, and I still have not received it. I ultimately had to advise the company that I would dispute the charge with my credit card because my refund requests were repeatedly denied. This experience has been very frustrating, and unfortunately I will not order from Macorner  again. I cannot recommend this company based on my experience.

The product arrived much later than expected, which was quite disappointing. However, the product itself is very nice and I'm happy with the quality. I also appreciate the customer service team for their help in tracking my order and keeping me updated. Thank you for your support. I hope the delivery time can be improved in the futuer ser
Mug came out just as pictured and my husband loved it.

I ordered a banner for a 4th of July parade.  When ordering it stated that it would be here by July 1st.  I Inquired about the timeframe to be sure we would get it in time.  Of course we did not.  When i questioned the company they stated.. " After reviewing your order, we can confirm that it was processed and shipped within our stated timeframe. At this time, the package is already in transit with the shipping carrier, so we're unable to offer a refund while the shipment is still actively on its way."  Not sure what i am going to do with this banner now that the parade is over!  Very disappointed.

I ordered several gifts for Mother’s Day and one was for my daughter’s first Mother’s Day as we were having a gathering. It had her name and my granddaughter and said first Mother’s Day. 2 days before Mother’s Day I was informed they lost my package, I had ordered over a month in advance. I didn’t get the item until 2 weeks later, I was so very upset. 
Then a couple of weeks before 4th of July, 2026 they advertised a personalized grandma shirt with all the kids names and that it was the 250th anniversary. I was hesitant to try them again but really liked the shirt. They said if I paid an additional $7.99 shipping they would deliver July 1-3. So I paid extra and ordered. On July 3 I was informed that my shirt would arrive on July 6. You can literally only wear that shirt on July 4, 2026!!!  Sadly I didn’t have a special shirt to wear on such an historic milestone in our country. I requested to be refunded the money I paid since the shirt is useless now and they replied that they would not issue a refund as it was personalized and that they did not guarantee delivery date, which was false information and why would they sell a shirt for a specific day if they can not deliver. I will NEVER  order from this horrible company again, and I buy many personalized items for myself and my precious family

there was a delivery issue which merchant had addressed quickly! this is how I remember businesses used to treat their customers- with respect.  the item was as described- my daughter loved it! this business is legitimate. definitely recommend.

I ordered the custom cutting board for father's day, "Everything tastes better when daddy grills it", cost $53.98, it is 5-1/2" wide by 11-1/2" long and 3/8"thick! It looks like walnut, cannot put food directly on it. Shame on Macorner for not putting sizes on ad and shame on me for not asking. It was extremely over priced! Very crappy scam.
Came as advertised and fast
great quality, soft T-shirt material, and good sizing.
Everything was good I got this for my mother for her 75 th birthday which isn’t until July 31st.

Update: I had already written to Macorner about the late shipment. (Funny that they say here that they cannot find the order with my name since I have already communicated with them twice.  And, since placing the order I have received numerous emails from them pushing for additional purchases.)
ANyway, this was their reply: After reviewing your order, we can confirm that the item This Daddy Belongs To Doodle - Personalized Sweatpants, Lounge Pants With Pockets was placed on June 9, shipped on June 13, and delivered in the time manner on June 23. Our production process typically takes 3-7 business days, and once shipped, an order is expected to arrive within 7-12 business days for Standard Shipping. While your order was delivered within our estimated delivery timeframe, we completely understand that meeting the occasion was what mattered most... As a gesture of appreciation for your patience, we’d like to offer you a 20% discount code for your next purchase.
I want to know why they still advertising Father's Day items when there is a good possibility it won't arrive on time. 
I got this on the 9th (the day I placed the order): "That Father’s Day gift you picked out? Safe, sound, and still looking like a solid choice if we’re being honest... Father’s Day’s getting closer every day, so come back, lock it in, and let future-you relax a little earlier this year."
FOUR days (the 13th) and 5 emails later, I get this: "It’s been a while since your last order, and we just wanted to say we’ve missed you! Since your last visit, quite a few new arrivals have joined the shop, and many have quickly become customer favorites." HUH? It's BEEN A WHILE???
TWO days after that (the 15th) I get an offer for 25% off a new order. (Yet they magnaminously offer a 20% in the non-apologetic apology letter they sent me after my complaint?)
That SAME day (the 15th), they send a 15% off email. 
And another on the 16th for 25%. 
Again on the 17th for 25%. They call it a birthday celebration but there are a lot of Father's Day items in the ad.
Another for the 17th but back to 15% and pics show Father's Day items.
Then on the 18th, they say next week is THEIR birthday and offer 30 exclusive uses of 30% off. And if that discount is gone, then 25%.
On the 23rd I get an email telling me there is still time for July 4th orders."...Yes, these crowd-pleasers will still make it in time for the big day--" (But, look in the non-apologetic apology. It states it takes at LEAST 3 business days to produce and 7 to ship. So that is AT LEAST  10 business days, plus at least 2 non-business days. That equals 12 days MINIMUM to get your order. Which would be past July 4th.) That is false advertising. 
So, Macorner, don't try to pin half of my Father's Day gifts being late on me. Perhaps if you spent less time automatically filling people's emails with your false and inconsistent ads, you could get your orders out in a timely manner. 

Original post:
I placed an order with Macorner for 2 Father's Day gifts. A personalized Grandpa shirt for my husband and Daddy sweatpants for my son-in-law.  The shirt arrived well within time, but the pants did not. They were extremely late. Almost a week AFTER Father's Day!
We had already put off sending our parcel to the family while waiting, but when Father's Day came and went we finally decided to send it without the pants. This was extremely disappointing, especially in light of the fact that our Son-in-law had adopted all of the children and this was his first Father's Day as their dad.   Plus, the first anniversary of the adoption was a week or so later and I wanted it to be a special celebration. Somehow, you screwed up. Bad. How could 2 items ordered at the same time come so far apart AND miss the occasion(s)? 
We are not impressed.
The ease of ordering the Father’s Day shirt was one that I will always remember. Your company truly hones in on customer service & satisfaction.

Terrible. The personalised pocket watch arrived and even though it looked lovely. In reality it was cheap rubbish. The watch rattled like bits and parts were lose. Follow the instructions to start it didn’t work. Eventually found were the battery went parts loose.
Tried to contact customer services very slow I asked for a refund  and details how to return. No response. Stay away

I ordered a memorial bench for my sister who lost her pet. When it eventually came it was made of cheap plywood and wouldn't last five minutes in the garden.  It wouldn't fit together and just kept falling apart. I contacted the company for a return address as I was so disgusted with the quality of the item for the money. Emails gave been backwards and forwards with asking for photos which I didn't see any point as they cannot see from photos why the item won't fit together or the quality of the wood. WILL NEVER BUY FROM HERE AGAIN AS IT'S A RIP OFF
Perfect shirt for our baby shower. Great shirt. The shirt fit well and material was very comfortable and true to size. I’ll be back!!!

My experience with Macorner has been nothing short of extremely disappointing and completely unacceptable.

I purchased what was intended to be a special birthday gift for my best friend. As soon as I noticed there was an issue with the shipping address, I contacted Macorner immediately and spent over a week trying to work with their customer service team to find a solution. Throughout this process, I was repeatedly assured that they would investigate the matter and liaise with the carrier.

Despite my efforts, the outcome was that I paid for a product that I never received.

What is most disappointing is that, after days of correspondence, Macorner ultimately accepted no responsibility, refused to provide either a refund or a replacement, and instead offered me a 40% discount to purchase the same item again. In other words, after already losing my money, I was expected to spend even more to replace a gift that I had already paid for.

As a customer, I find this unacceptable. A business should be judged not by how it performs when everything goes smoothly, but by how it resolves problems when they arise. In this case, there was no genuine attempt to ensure that I received the product I had purchased or to provide a fair resolution.

The result is simple: I paid for a gift that never arrived, my best friend never received her birthday present, and I have been left out of pocket with nothing to show for it.

This experience has completely eroded my confidence in Macorner. I cannot recommend purchasing from a company that is unwilling to stand behind its customers when something goes wrong.

Mark and the team were exceptional in helping me with a replacement Classic Cap. He remained in contact throughout the process and I am now the proud owner of the '1946 in Blue' Classic Cap. It fits perfectly and I will wearing it the next I go anywhere. Many thanks again for you and your teams Customer Service. Outstanding.
Best Regards, Chris.
They have a great selection, the products I ordered were well-made (mugs) and fast service.  I recommend them.
The cup was beautiful and picture put on accurately.  The packaging was perfect and prevented the cupfrom damage during transport. Very happy with the purchase😄

Super easy to order and very fast delivery. 
The mug is absolutely perfect!! It was a very loved gift!

I ordered one of their engraved belts with a click latch to tighten for my boyfriend for Fathers Day! To start, the quality of the product is excellent! The engraving is clear and easy to read, the belt itself looks very clean, sturdy and great quality, and the buckle just pulls it all together into a sleek, beautiful piece! My boyfriends old belt was falling apart, held together with electrical tape, and causing him to breakout on his stomach where the belt buckle would touch his skin. He has told me numerous times how much he really likes the new belt! He really likes the way it clicks to latch and unlatch, how easily you can cut and shorten it, and the best part....the rash the other belt caused has completely healed since he started wearing this new one! Definitely worth the buy!

I had ordered the garage sign.Very happy with product. Was exactly as described. Would highly recommend. I had made an error on my order and the company quickly corrected it and set the order straight. Something I really much appreciated. Thank you.

DO NOT BUY FROM THIS COMPANY! They send very poor quality items that don’t meet descriptions or sizes and then refuse refunds despite saying they do give refund! I bought a personalised polo shirt for my husband which was shown as a cotton mat finish high quality shirt. What arrived was a shiny smelly thing that looked like a very cheap badly made bowling shirt. It was also much smaller than advertised. Importantly it was smaller by a greater margin than Macorner say that they allow for manufacturing difference and yet they have still refused to refund me. I have logged a complaint with the UK Consumer Rights Org.
The process was easy and the shirts turned out great! Everyone loved them!
Great quality product with super fast shipping time. I will definitely be  ordering from here again.

Terrible experience. Completely different photo was sent on the product I ordered as a gift. Still waiting on replacement, it’s been several weeks. Needless to say the gift opportunity has passed and no discount for the inconvenience. Delayed replies. Overall I would discourage use of this site and I will not be ordering anything from them again.

I apparently got what I ordered, but I thought my acrylic scrabble ornaments that came were going to be glass.  I had received a glass ornament last year from my brother.  I planned to order one customized ornament for my adult four children.  I clicked on what I initially saw and was not aware they were acrylic, not glass.  I do not order on-line much at all, but now I know to really make sure to know what I specifically want to order.  Oh well, it is the thought that counts and I'm sure my children will appreciate what they receive.  Thank you for your creativeness!

I ordered 2 personalised golf “towels” they look and feel like they have been printed on what look like dish cloths. I ordered on 6th June and products only just delivered so missed Father’s Day. The quality is so poor and I am too embarrassed to give these to my husband and father to hang on their golf buggies. The cheapest quality and £21 EACH😡😡😡😡😡😡. I would like a full refund of these products.

Leveringstiden er lidt lang, hvilket de også skriver, så ingen overraskelse der. Der er fin information og tracking hele vejen, og produktet lever fuldt op til forventningerne. Det er første gang jeg har handlet her, men det bliver ikke sidste! ☺️
I ordered this on June 4th and it is somewhere, anywhere but here. When I track the package there is no further information since June 9th. I have been charged but no item. pretty disapointed.
The shirt came out beautiful

Ordering was easy and delivery was pretty fast. I ordered a few things and everything  i recieved was perfect and my dad and my husband loved what they got. My husband got a personalized shirt and my dad got a belt...it made my dad cry happy tears. I Love all the stuff they have and definitely  will be ordering more.
Ordered 6/14 received 6/20 and found item exactly as advertised and how I ordered.  Upon wearing it people who saw it gave positive comments.
Would definitely’ we got good laughs for Father’s Day! Will reorder again

The products I ordered took a long time arrive and when they did one was so damaged it was useless (hat) and the other was not as described. It was described as a sweater and was really a cheap sweatshirt. These things were part of a 70th birthday gift and I would be embarrassed to gift them. They would not offer a return or refund but after much back and forth offered a new hat. Stay away from this company. Bad products, bad experience. Waste of money.
The solution they refer to in their response is 10% off the sweatshirt. This response is not helpful. I wanted to return the whole thing and be reimbursed for the shipping but this was not offered. Still very dissatisfied.

I ordered 3 things a personalized shirt for my husband, a hat and the phases of the moon. The shirt was good cute and what i expected, the hat was cheap feels cheap and looks cheap, the phases of the moon on the day you were born is a colossal disappointment! No bigger than my hand with 6 kids on it. What a total waste of money! Ordered in plenty of time for Father’s Day and still arrived late! (The phases of the moon gift that is) the share was cute and worth what I paid, but I would not buy from this retailer again huge disappointment, big fat waste of money.

Absolutely terrible customer service all around! 

Ordered a personalised gift with my childrens picture for fathers day - the website claimed delivery would be before then. 

We are now 3 days away from fathers day and my package today with my children’s photo has been left outside a random person’s door! 

Hazel from CS has denied me a full refund and cancellation of the order which was rightly requested and as a result has led to this scenario to unfold. 
I have requested in every email that she passes on the matter so someone more capable to deal with customers. 

She has however kindly offered me 20% off my next purchase and has returned initially 50% of my postage and today kindly claimed to have returned the remainder! 

Her advice for safeguarding my children’s face and personalised item is to “check the neighbourhood and ask around”.

Absolutely disgusting.
I bought the sweatshirt as a gift and it did not disappoint. Love the design and the sweatshirt is soft.
I haven’t received my order, nothing but empty words, pretending to help me. Such a big disappointment.

when I contacted Macorner with the issue of a double order/charge, they immediately responded, rectified the problem and issued a refund within 48 hrs. 
The product is exactly as described and it arrived within the time promised (for Father's Day) which is rare nowadays. Thank you for a lovely product and for the great service!

This company has horrible customer service! My product came and was made wrong and they said it wasn’t!  I posted a previous review on here and they responded to it saying that they couldn’t find my order!  Very funny because they have been corresponding with me about the order on my email! And have been trying to offer me 10% off then the next email came with 20% off! And all I was asking for was for them to honor their replacement because I wanted a replacement not to keep the defective T-shirt! And I wrote a previous review about the product and they act like they can’t find the order! So lesson learned and I’m trying to make everybody aware not to purchase from this company!
The staff at Maconer was great  I was on a time crunch and they delivered right on time    these were given as gifts and they were a big hit
Ordering was simple and items were exactly as described! They arrived quickly and my husband and stepfather were over the moon excited about this one of a kind gift!

The entire process was so easy and best part is that it arrived right in time. My husband loved the t-shirt. He likes shirts with the sayings in the back, that is the only thing I would say you should offer. If that can be done, please let me know and I will order another.

The girls on the hats look like they have bob hair cuts and the way the five kids were all slanting down row of each other looked cheap. Last year they all looked like they were peeking out from the hat and this year they’re just in a down hill slope. They don’t look like they’re kids peeking over the hat front frame area. It’s ugly! Now they won’t give me back my money!

I have ordered multiple items in the past with 0 issues.  This past time, there was a printing issue.  I reached out and the customer service was phenomenal.   Within a week they shipped me the replacement item and everything was perfect.  I dont anticipate issues, but it was reassuring to know that when one does arrise, they are on their game to correct it.

Got a personalized shirt for my husband for Father’s Day and he absolutely loves it! It’s great quality, they had some awesome colors to choose from and the shipping time was much quicker than I anticipated. Their customer service was also fantastic, as I had made errors with my shipping info and they made it very easy to correct it quickly, before any problems arose. Will definitely order from them again!

The product is fabulous quality, the sizing is perfect, the graphics beautifully aligned and high-quality. This is a prime example of a product matching the description and the photos. It helps that shipping was quick and package arrived in tact. I'll definitely be ordering from Macorner again!

Ordered a fathers day gift almost a month ago aware that some feedback related to long shipping times. As expected shipping took a while, but the tracking info shows the package has bounced around, delivery has never been attempted and now it's now on its way back to China with no communication to me as the customer at all. I'm now anticipating a battle for a refund. 
Strongly recommend not ordering from them.

STAY AWAY FROM MACORNER!

I bought a memorial car viser. It came in about a week and a half. It came in an envelope, it was a thin piece of wood and a clip not attached. I email the company and they ask that I send them pictures of the viser, and package. Then they tell me to attach the clip to back with adhesive strip. So I email back saying I had no adhesive strip, they ask for more pictures. So I send pictures of clip. After multiple attempts of getting my refund , there fix is sending me the adhesive strip or a 10% refund. First of all the item should have came together for the amount of money I payed. Second if they expect you to put it together it should be in item description and all pieces and instructions sent. DO NOT BUY FROM MACORNER. Poor quality and horrible customer service.
My husband loved the Dad Jokes mug.  He looks forward to a new one every day anbd giggles when he gets the groans.  Very cute idea.

The shipment took about 2 weeks, but it was absolutely worth the wait. When I received my product and it turned out to be the wrong color, customer service was very friendly and helpful. We worked together to find a solution to the problem. They remained friendly and professional throughout. I will definitely buy from Macorner again!
Great products!

I had a great experience with them. I went to go check the tracking about a week and a half after ordering and there was some kind of glitch where there was no updated information so I emailed the company. Not only they respond within 20 minutes saying they would look into it and to please give them 24 hours they actually responded in 24 hours with an updated tracking number. It arrived two days ago. After it was delivered the even when out of their way to make sure that I had in fact received it. I know a lot of these companies can be questionable nowadays but I can speak pretty confidently that this company is not one of those companies. They actually have a real customer service team in place who actually care about their customers. And another amazing thing is what it says it's Canadian dollars it's actually Canadian dollars (You can sometimes order from companies that claim they're from Canada but they charge in USD) I will definitely be using this company again!

Well after a lot of wasted time, having evidence dismissed because of how I took photos, the picture is still not central on the mug, it needs to be moved at least one cm to the right to be central.  The replacement they sent never had the original flaw between the cup and transfer but the transfer is still off centre. I haven’t asked for much I just want the £35 dog mug that I saw on instagram not the one they sent. I want no white strip around the handle, like the video, and I want the picture to be central, not off to the side, like the video.  I have been offered 10 percent off my next purchase but why would I order off a company who doesn’t send what they advertise.  


An update I have just been sent £3.50, which is 10 percent of the mug price.  All I wanted was the mistake corrected and it wasn’t.  I DO NOT TRUST this company anymore 

Update:
I have been given a full refund for the mug as I finally provided adequate proof, this was done by using a tape measure.  After a long drawn out and unnecessary process, I have been asked to review or delete my review.  I said I would edit once I  had the refund.  I have received the refund and a new email prompting me to delete my reviews. Timely shipment, no scam.

Shirt and graphics are good quality. Processing and delivery was much quicker than I thought. Will definitely purchase things from them again in the future

After initially feeling very upset and distressed because my order went missing, I can honestly say I am now extremely happy with both my purchase and the customer service I received from Macorner.

Luna dealt with my case in a speedy, professional, and efficient manner, and I truly appreciated the communication and support throughout the process. The replacement finally arrived, and it was absolutely worth the wait. The item is beautiful, meaningful, and very well made.

Thank you, Luna, for turning a stressful situation into a positive experience. Excellent customer care makes all the difference, and I would happily purchase from Macorner again. 🙏🏽✨

I ordered the wooden bear family puzzle cutouts for my two sons for Fathers day. Items arrived and the quality was great.  All names spelled correctly. The first delivery was lost in the USPS mail system, but the company Macorner re send a second set for free, it arrived via GOFO and I am very happy. They strive to keep the customer happy. Thank you
Just as advertised and shipped quickly.

Everything was as promised.

Bad experience. The shirt came quickly and looked exactly as I expected.  My husband loves his gift.

I wrote to them, asking for a refund (I paid it 35 USD), after 2 detailed emails, they offered me 5 USD refund. I do not recommend this site.

My ordered came in wrong twice, they won’t refund my money, still waiting for response.  The reviews on google said they are terrible when it comes to description of your order.  I will not order from this website again.  VERY DISAPPOINTED ☹️

It’s so nice to have a company that gets your item to you in a timely manner!  That aside, it’s a good quality t-shirt. I’ll be back!

I accidentally put the wrong size for a tee shirt, I did contact Macorner and explained, they were wonderful fixed it,emailed me for approval on the order, and shipped it right out. My husband loves the shirt and I love the customer service. More than 5 star's 
Thank you again.
Great product. Fast shipping. Very happy with the experience.
Very good service and expedited delivery.
